title: 🏗️ Cranberry Township engineering roles with several $80K+ options
text:
7 hours ago Cranberry Township is busy in engineering right now, especially around transportation and clean energy. Here are several solid roles worth a look if you’re in architecture or engineering.
Senior Project Engineer - Traffic Employer: GAI Consultants, Inc. Location: Cranberry, PA (plus Homestead or Southpointe options) Type: Full-time Salary: Not listed Lead traffic engineering work for PennDOT/PA Turnpike style projects, including traffic modeling, signals, signing/marking, and traffic control plans. This one is ideal if you have 16+ years’ experience , a P.E. , and want to guide complex projects while mentoring others.
Licensing Engineer II – Advanced Nuclear Employer: Westinghouse Electric Company Location: Cranberry Township, PA (hybrid; ~2 days in office) Type: Full-time Salary: $69,200–$86,500/year (dependent on experience) Support licensing and regulatory strategy for new nuclear plants and advanced reactor projects. Good fit if you have 3+ years in engineering, know NRC regulations and nuclear licensing (10 CFR 50.59, license amendments, etc.) , and want to work on the next wave of clean energy.
Senior Project Engineer – Nuclear Fuel / Reload Employer: Westinghouse Electric Company (listed under Laveer Engineering) Location: Cranberry Township, PA (hybrid) Type: Full-time Salary: $85,200–$106,500/year (dependent on experience) Act as the primary customer interface for nuclear fuel reload engineering projects, leading small cross‑functional teams and managing scope, schedule, and financials. Best for engineers with 3+ years in a technical or project management role who like client-facing work and coordinating complex nuclear projects.
If one of these fits your skills, don’t sit on it—click through, skim the full posting, and apply while it’s fresh.
Please note: Job listings change quickly. Some positions listed here may have already been filled, and links may no longer be active. Contact the employer or visit the official website directly for the most up-to-date information.
